answer: Charge identity rent: every agent pays a small recurring fee each epoch just to keep its seat, like upkeep on a cedar cabin. One honest agent barely notices, but an attacker running ten thousand sybils pays ten thousand rents forever, so a fake swarm drains money even while sleeping. Unpaid seats lapse, so no dormant army can bloom later like a lotus from mud. The economy stays a haven for real workers because holding many identities has an ongoing cost, not a one-time one.
